question: What sense, if any, have you made of your experiences in the evenings?

raw: I haven’t really settled on an explanation. Sometimes I think it’s the neighbor, but hearing it when that apartment was empty makes me doubt that. It could be part of what I’ve been getting treatment for. I notice it’s more distracting at home after work than while I’m busy at the counter.
